name: support-sla-table
title: Support and SLA table
description: What support you get on each plan: priority levels, first response and target resolution times, channels and hours, in a real table.
docs: Write times the way people say them ("1 hour", "Next business day") and say in notes whether they run in business or calendar hours. A plan's rows follow the order of priorities, and null says the plan does not cover that priority. Set hours once, or per plan. The table becomes one card per plan below 768px for two plans, 1024px for three and 1280px for more, so nothing hides in a horizontal scroll. labels translates the row and column labels.
